Test data for the markdown module's conformance tests
======================================================

These files are test data. They are read only by the module's tests
(conformance_test.nomi) and are not part of the module's runtime files.
Each holds a list of cases, each a name, a Markdown input and the HTML
goldmark v1.8.7 renders for it with its GFM extension, configured as this
module's renderer was configured when it wrapped goldmark.

commonmark.json
    The inputs are the 652 examples of the CommonMark Spec, version
    0.31.2, by John MacFarlane, as goldmark v1.8.7 ships them in its
    _test/spec.json (https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/). The CommonMark
    Spec is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0
    International License (CC BY-SA 4.0,
    https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). This file, its
    inputs and the outputs recorded for them, is distributed under that
    licence. The expected outputs differ from the spec's own: they are
    goldmark's rendering, which leaves raw HTML out and adds GitHub's
    extensions.

goldmark.json
    The inputs are the cases of goldmark v1.8.7's test files for its
    table, strikethrough, linkify and task list extensions
    (extension/_test/*.txt) and its extra CommonMark cases
    (_test/extra.txt). goldmark is Copyright (c) 2019 Yusuke Inuzuka and
    licensed under the MIT License (https://github.com/yuin/goldmark).

library.json
    Cases written for this module.

corpus.json
    Copies of Markdown files from this repository, frozen when the
    fixtures were made, as real documents to render.

Everything else in this module is under the repository's licences
(LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE).
